label: deepseek-v4-pro-novita

label: anthropic-sonnet-5
_role: MODEL variable, and the decisive one. If this leg honours the per-node words= directive where DeepSeek delivered 39-53 percent, then the shortfall is a MODEL property and the remedy is model selection, not a new gate rule. If it under-delivers too, the shortfall is a PROMPT property and UW-C307's fill-rate gate is the right fix. vendors.json calls this the checkpoint the pipeline actually runs.
_endpoint_verified: 2026-08-20, 200, served by Amazon Bedrock. First-party anthropic returns 404 under this account's data policy, same as vendors.json records.
